summary: Starwood Property Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the commencement of a private offering of $500 million aggregate principal amount of unsecured senior notes due 2029. Net proceeds will be allocated to eligible green and/or social projects, with interim use for redeeming up to $500 million of its 4.375% Senior Notes due 2027 or for general corporate purposes. The offering is limited to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A and non-U.S. persons under Regulation S; the notes are unregistered. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
